summary: Scoped local-store reads per company via boardScopedType so synced rows for one company never leak into another company's local list/get.
reason: The generated resolveLocal reads the unscoped resource type, so a company-scoped sync (postings:stripe) could never be read back, and syncing a second company would return a mix. boardScopedType derives 'postings:<company>' from the path template for list and get-by-ID local reads, matching the sync command's write keys. Note: Lever paths lead with the resource segment ('/postings/{company}'), so the company is the SECOND path segment; the greenhouse package's helper reads the first segment because its paths lead with the board token. Mirrors the greenhouse package's scoped-read fix, adapted to the lever path shape.
validated_outcome: Full go test ./... suite green on Windows (11 packages); live end-to-end verified in an isolated env: sync leverdemo (388) + sync palantir (301) both persist, and --data-source local returns only the requested company's postings (388 vs 301, never mixed).
